description: server.rs:349-358 falls back to user_id=1 when the authenticated username is not in the DB. In single-user v1 with dev-mode this never fires, but with OIDC/credential auth enabled, an unprovisioned OIDC user would silently get user_id=1 instead of a 503. Filed from JMAP review round 1 (stoa-77a34b60).
title: fix(mail): silent SINGLETON_USER_ID fallback when username not found
